features.feature: A rebuild preserves the platform executable contract before old-dist eviction: POSIX bin targets gain executable access while Windows keeps a byte-identical Node entrypoint usable through npm command shims.

Missing or syntactically invalid package manifests, missing bin fields, and ENOENT targets are benign; other manifest read, stat, realpath, or chmod failures propagate before the working dist is replaced.
Promotion rejects non-files plus final and intermediate symlink escapes and preserves the existing dist whenever staging validation fails.
The registered red regression emits stable GREEN and contract selectors on the repaired candidate, remains discriminating against the unfixed baseline, and is present in validation configuration.

Doctor emits the healthy marker only when the installed global package, PATH-selected command, declared bin-target realpath, compiled version, and host executable contract agree; package presence alone cannot substitute for PATH presence.
Doctor resolves the declared bin target and rejects final or intermediate escapes outside the canonical package dist tree, preserving errno evidence for failed probes.
On POSIX doctor validates executable access and renders safely quoted shell remediation; mode is an observed fact rather than a universal cross-platform promise.

On Windows doctor validates the actual PATH-selected npm command shim and renders encoded PowerShell LiteralPath remediation preserving spaces, apostrophes, and percent tokens without relying on POSIX mode bits.
Capability skips and zero-assertion paths cannot emit the must PASS selector, while non-link Windows assertions still execute.
Mode restoration does not alter byte-content binding semantics, so a later build may still take the content-bound fast path.

Commit d65767d4b16e repairs F-029 through F-036 only through the four declared touchpoints: promote-dist.mjs, runtime-environment-checks.ts, red-global-cli-exec-bit.mjs, and global-core-realpath.test.mjs; no unrelated medium or low issue expands scope.
Do not alter Codex adapter entrypoint authority, npm link or global-install mechanics, or protected build-lock/crash-safety design; doctor remains read-only and only reports remediation.
